other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam
Applicant must be engaged in any building & other construction work
Applicant must be registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Applicant must have an active membership with the Board
Beneficiary must be hospitalized, or have partial disability due to an accident, or suffer from critical diseases such as cancer, heart attack, kidney failure, liver cirrhosis, etc.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹20,000 for hospitalization and up to ₹1.5 Lakh for partial disability or critical diseases, as decided by the Board.
